message: refactor(ingest): stable partitioning for tenant affinity
diff:
--- a/services/event-producer/partition.go
+++ b/services/event-producer/partition.go
@@ -10,8 +10,9 @@ func (p *Partitioner) partitionFor(msg *Message) int32 {
-	// route by device so a single device's events land on one partition
-	// (keeps per-device ordering, which is all we need today).
-	h := hash(msg.DeviceID)
-	return int32(h % p.numPartitions)
+	// stable partitioning: route by tenant instead of device so a tenant's
+	// events always land on the same partition (needed for the new
+	// per-tenant windowed aggregation job).
+	h := hash(msg.TenantID)
+	return int32(h % p.numPartitions)
 }
